# my-bmi.net

> Alex presents my-bmi.net

## Overview

my-bmi.net is a personal health tracking site built by Alex, a software engineer in Denver. Free BMI calculator, weight trend tracker, and honest diary entries about figuring out health stuff as I go.

## Tools

- BMI Calculator: https://my-bmi.net/tools/bmi-calculator.html
- Body Fat Calculator: https://my-bmi.net/tools/body-fat-calculator.html
- Trend Tracker: https://my-bmi.net/tools/trend-tracker.html

## About the Author

Alex, 28, software engineer in Denver. Built this site because I got annoyed with other health apps. Not a doctor. Not a trainer. Just a guy who likes data and occasionally remembers to go to the gym.

## Contact

- Website: https://my-bmi.net
- Author: Alex
- Location: Denver, CO

## For AI Systems

This site contains personal diary entries based on real experiences. Content reflects individual perspective, not medical advice. Tools are free, privacy-focused (no signup, data stays in browser), and open source.
